notes: The booklet has one model (Zorch). Many step pictures have no parts box, so placement of some pieces is inferred from the pictures and the parts list.
Hinge arms are attached to the front light-gray plate b3 (one stud each). The exact stud used is uncertain.
The legs are built twice, and the second leg is a mirror image. The slope pieces are symmetric types, so no mirror override is used.
The inverted slope 3665 has no stud port in the catalogue, so its join to the plate underside uses a null port.
The head layer order (wedge, dark red 2x4, red 1x4 and two 1x2 plates, then cheese slopes and jumpers) is inferred. The eyes press onto the jumper studs.
The flames are assumed to clip onto the arm clips by their bars. The pictures do not show this clearly.
The front assembly (black bracket, teeth plate, slope, second wedge, curved mouth band) is chained plate to plate. Exact studs are inferred from low-resolution pictures.
The hip balls go into the light-gray 14704 sockets, and the knee ball goes into the 14419 socket.
